data.name: Ocean and You
data.headline: 20% Off! with Code Fall20 (Friday tours excluded) – Waikiki Booze Cruise with Live DJ!
data.description: Join us for a night of fun on the all-new 2020 powerboat, featuring surround sound, mood lighting, wraparound seating, and a live DJ. Party while taking in stunning views of Diamond Head and the Waikiki coastline. On Fridays, enjoy a special fireworks show over the ocean.
data.highlights:
- Sail on a luxury 2020 powerboat with a live DJ and party atmosphere
- Enjoy scenic views of Diamond Head and the Waikiki coastline
- Watch fireworks on Fridays
- Free drink ticket included
- **Upgrade to an Endless Dream Cup for unlimited refills on select drinks**
data.itinerary:
- Stop 1: Sail along the Waikiki coastline, taking in views of Diamond Head
- Stop 2: Party and dance to a live DJ
- Stop 3: Spot potential marine wildlife, such as dolphins, whales, or turtles
- Stop 4: Fireworks show (Fridays only)

meeting_point.address: 1125 Ala Moana Blvd D111 Honolulu, HI US 96814

data.what_is_included:
- One free drink ticket per person ( Beer or Seltzer)
- Fireworks show (Fridays only)
- DJ music and dancing on board
- Party on a double-decker boat with wraparound seating
data.what_is_not_included:
- Additional drinks ($6 beer/seltzer/soft drinks, $12 liquor/cocktails)
- Endless Dream Cup upgrades available for purchase
data.what_to_bring:
- Long-sleeve jacket or sweatshirt
- Motion sickness medicine (if needed)
- Valid ID for guests 21+
- Cash or card for purchasing drinks on board
data.cancellation_summary: Cancellations or changes must be made at least 48 hours before the departure time for a full refund
data.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation Policy**
Any cancellations or amendments (tour date, time, etc.) must be made at least 48 hours prior to the departure time on the reservation date to receive a full refund of the tour fees.

Reservations made within 48 hours of departure are considered FINAL SALE. Please be aware that we do not provide refunds for no-shows or late arrivals.

**Combo/Upsell Packages**
Combo or upsell bookings cannot be partially canceled. Cancellations must be made for all tours within the package. 

If one tour has already been used and you wish to cancel the remaining tour, no refund will be issued.

**Doctor's Note Exception**
With a valid doctor's note, a full refund may be issued after the designated cancellation period.
- The doctor's note applies only to the person named on the note
- If the person holding the note is a minor (under 12 years old), we will also honor one adult guardian for a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
#ALOHA,
Thank you for booking your **Ocean and You** tour with [And You Creations](https://andyoucreations.com/). 

Please meet us at the Kewalo Basin Harbor 30 minutes before departure, located in the Kaka’ako District of Honolulu along Ala Moana Boulevard, between Ward Avenue and Ala Moana Park Drive.
Address: 1125 Ala Moana Blvd, Honolulu, HI 96814 (Pier D Gate #111)

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/ECbwWcyQZmqPi0N5Elah)

**If you are parking, limited parking is available in Kewalo Basin Park at *$2.50 per hour***. 

The parking lot for members and visitors is located on the Diamond Head side of the harbor. Stalls in front of the charter boats are reserved for those members only.

Please read through this entire email for important general information regarding your tour. Don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or special requests.

Mahalo!

_________________________


#WHAT TO BRING:
- Long-sleeve Jacket or Sweat Shirt
- Motion Sickness Medicine (For those who are prone to getting seasick, we recommend taking medication an hour before the tour start time)
- Adult beverages will be available for purchase on the boat. Hard liquor goes from $6 to $12. Soft drinks, Beer and Seltzers are $6.*One free drink ticket per person is included in the tour fee.*
- Valid ID for 21+ 

**No outside alcoholic beverages allowed**

**You will be asked to remove your shoes before boarding the boat. This is for your safety. We will have storage for you to place them in during your time onboard. Clean reef shoes and grip socks are permitted.**

*Please limit your belongings to one bag per group due to limited space on the boat.

*If you have a US number that we can reach out, please contact us. 

*Smoking, vaping, alcohol consumption, and the use or possession of illegal drugs are not permitted on our premises, including our buses and boats. Guests who do not comply with this policy may be denied service or removed from the premises at our discretion, without refund.

 _________________________

Get ready for a memorable night off the coast of Waikiki!

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/xDaF9lF8RH6iKfw9tvUh)

data.faqs:
- **Can I bring my own alcohol?** No, outside alcoholic beverages are not allowed.
- **Is parking available?** Yes, but parking is limited. Uber or taxis are recommended if you plan on consuming alcohol.
